sites.name: Phu Quoc Prison Relic
sites.event: Known as 'Hell on Earth', where more than 40,000 prisoners of war were held during the resistance war against the US.

sites.name: Mac Cuu Tombs Relic Area
sites.event: The place of worship and resting place of Governor Mac Cuu and the Mac family - those who contributed to reclaiming and defending the land of Ha Tien.

sites.name: Nguyen Trung Truc Temple
sites.event: The place of worship for National Hero Nguyen Trung Truc, famous for his saying: 'Only when the Westerners pull up all the grass of the South will the Southern people stop fighting them'.

sites.name: U Minh Thuong National Park
sites.event: A world biosphere reserve, which used to be a revolutionary base (Zone 9 Party Committee) during the two resistance wars.

place.commune: An Minh Bac Commune, Minh Thuan Commune

sites.name: Thach Dong (Thach Dong Thon Van)
sites.event: A limestone cave associated with the legend of Thach Sanh slaying the ogre to rescue the princess.

sites.name: Nam Du Archipelago
sites.event: A pristine and beautiful archipelago of 21 large and small islands, likened to a miniature 'Ha Long Bay' in the West Sea.

place.commune: An Son Commune, Nam Du Commune

sites.name: Hon Dat Historical Relic Area (Ba Hon)
sites.event: The site of a fierce battle in 1962 and the place of sacrifice of the Hero of the People's Armed Forces Phan Thi Rang (the prototype of Sister Su in the novel 'Hon Dat').

sites.name: Hon Phu Tu - Chua Hang Scenic Landscape
sites.event: A landscape symbol of Kien Giang associated with the legend of a father and son slaying a sea monster; Chua Hang (Hai Son Pagoda) is located inside a limestone mountain.

sites.name: Rach Gia Tam Quan Gate
sites.event: An iconic architectural work, a 'greeting' from the coastal city of Rach Gia, built during the French colonial period.

sites.name: Sao Beach
sites.event: One of the most beautiful beaches in Phu Quoc with creamy white sand and turquoise water.

sites.name: Ba Lua Archipelago
sites.event: An island cluster of more than 40 large and small islands, famous for its shallow waters where you can walk from one island to another.

sites.name: Hung King Temple
sites.event: The oldest and largest place of worship for the Hung Kings in the Western region, showing the gratitude to the roots of the pioneers.
